identity: Stage 10 analysis conventions before independent confirmation
status: analysis conventions specified; sample sizes, seeds and executable freeze pending

primary_pair.positive_direction: lower cumulative loss for the numerically audited full restorer
primary_pair.independence: independent streams across trajectories and settings; paired methods within each trajectory
primary_pair.loss: sum of weighted squared state error over the prescribed 512-frame window

primary_estimand: Delta = sum_g weight_g * E[D_gi] under the five-setting design distribution

primary_interval.method: two-sided approximate stratified Welch-Satterthwaite t interval
primary_interval.zero_estimated_variance: report the degenerate estimated interval and all group counts and losses
primary_interval.secondary_results: setting-specific and ablation intervals carry descriptive labels unless an additional confirmatory procedure is frozen before samples

healthy_action.effective_action: exact binary rational difference between actual monitor and published binary64 state
healthy_action.any_action: effective_action != 0 in at least one coordinate
healthy_action.rate_unit: fraction of independent healthy trajectories with at least one qualifying action

query_cost.clock: wall-clock elapsed time using a declared monotonic high-resolution timer
across_trajectories: equal-trajectory summaries of per-trajectory P50 and P95
distribution of trajectory maximum query time
query_cost.zero_query_trajectory: retain trajectory with count 0, sum 0 and null query quantiles and maximum
query_cost.end_to_end: include prediction, gain/covariance, reference, candidates, proposals, envelope, provenance, search and effective-output audit

unresolved_and_censoring: retain all frozen trajectories, annotate reasons and right-censor certificate waiting times
